title: Run commutes with tape embedding
statement: Let $M$ be a machine with $m$ work tapes, embed those tape indices into $k$ work tapes, and form a $k$-tape configuration by placing $c$'s tapes and head positions at the embedded indices, using arbitrary initial contents and head positions elsewhere, and prefixing its output by a fixed word. For every natural number $t$, running the embedded machine for $t$ steps gives exactly the configuration formed in the same way from the configuration reached by running $M$ from $c$ for $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices
A machine $M$, initial tape contents and head positions, an output prefix, and an $m$-tape configuration $c$
